baseline.scope: Four unfiltered viewports across List and Grid on iPhone 17e with iOS 27. The counts include repeated reports for a control seen in more than one viewport.

unfilteredFollowUp.scope: Grid used separately scrollable pairs of days and reflowed the same controls for accessibility sizes. The high-contrast Week heading passed. The inline title remained visible and opaque edges kept scrolled content clear of the tab bar. The original Spanish test then failed to search upward for the week link after returning to a scrolled Dinners root.

contrastProbe.finding: All reported frames intersected or fell outside an opaque scroll edge in the captured viewport. The same Sunday heading and note were fully visible at the end of the week, where the contrast audit recorded zero issues. The diagnostic result retains the four original reports.

spanishIOS27.scope: Same meal and lunch IDs in both presentations, native Back and tab return, exact date note, restart and rediscovery with the corrected bidirectional search.

crossWeekIOS17.scope: The same dinner moved across weeks and the protected lunch stayed on its original day after relaunch. The test uses the scoped iOS 17 logging accommodation.

rightToLeftSpanishIOS17.configuration: Ordinary arm64 Debug on an isolated iPhone SE, iOS 17.0 (21A328)
rightToLeftSpanishIOS17.initialFinding: The standard Spanish journey saved and reopened its meal week. With only AppleTextDirection set, the native Back control was still on the left, and the direction assertion stopped the test.
rightToLeftSpanishIOS17.scope: The two native launch options visible in the installed Xcode launcher mirrored the same Spanish week and placed Back on the right. Meal and lunch IDs, original wording, the two-unit reservation and its purpose survived relaunch. Tapping the next date opened the corresponding note and native Back returned to the week. The scoped iOS 17 app logging accommodation was active.

pickupScopeIOS17.scope: The initial tests stalled because XCTest found the visible, enabled SwiftUI menu without a hit point. The rerun verified its complete frame and tapped its center. Both menus opened and the Start another pickup item worked. After switching, the previous week remained scoped to the original pickup. The former draft and its review action became inaccessible, and the new pickup opened a fresh reservation form.

currentModels.configuration: Ordinary arm64 Debug on iPhone 17e, iOS 27.0 (24A434)

largestSystemText.scope: Consecutive dates have the same leading column position at the largest system text setting. The test scrolled the full frame of each captured control into the unobscured viewport. The saved dinner and lunch labels retain the original Spanish text and quantity. Tapping the second note opens the exact next civil day. Simulator settings were restored afterward.
